title: Mike and gcd problem
statementMd:
Mike has a sequence $*A* = [*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}]$ of length $*n*$. He considers the sequence $*B* = [*b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, ..., *b*_{*n*}]$ beautiful if the $*gcd*$ of all its elements is bigger than $1$, i.e. ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1829934399ec1245c6050a62cf6e36810163b03b.png).

Mike wants to change his sequence in order to make it beautiful. In one move he can choose an index $*i*$ ($1 ≤ *i* < *n*$), delete numbers $*a*_{*i*}, *a*_{*i* + 1}$ and put numbers $*a*_{*i*} - *a*_{*i* + 1}, *a*_{*i*} + *a*_{*i* + 1}$ in their place instead, in this order. He wants perform as few operations as possible. Find the minimal number of operations to make sequence $*A*$ beautiful if it's possible, or tell him that it is impossible to do so.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/69b4319fc56f0d760506d7f84e7647ff65f6bdc5.png) is the biggest non-negative number $*d*$ such that $*d*$ divides $*b*_{*i*}$ for every $*i*$ ($1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n*$).

## Input

The first line contains a single integer $*n*$ ($2 ≤ *n* ≤ 100 000$) — length of sequence $*A*$.

The second line contains $*n*$ space-separated integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$) — elements of sequence $*A*$.

## Output

Output on the first line "`YES`" (without quotes) if it is possible to make sequence $*A*$ beautiful by performing operations described above, and "`NO`" (without quotes) otherwise.

If the answer was "`YES`", output the minimal number of moves needed to make sequence $*A*$ beautiful.

## Note

In the first example you can simply make one move to obtain sequence $[0, 2]$ with ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6ddb490b8e898198d30c56c6edce2cf15e6f998a.png).

In the second example the $*gcd*$ of the sequence is already greater than $1$.
statementZhMd:
Mike 有一个长度为 $*n*$ 的序列 $*A* = [*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}]$。如果序列 $*B* = [*b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, ..., *b*_{*n*}]$ 中所有元素的 $*gcd*$ 大于 $1$，那么他认为序列 $*B*$ 是美丽的，即 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1829934399ec1245c6050a62cf6e36810163b03b.png)。

Mike 想要改变他的序列，使其变得美丽。一次操作中，他可以选择一个下标 $*i*$（$1 ≤ *i* < *n*$），删除数字 $*a*_{*i*}, *a*_{*i* + 1}$，并按此顺序将数字 $*a*_{*i*} - *a*_{*i* + 1}, *a*_{*i*} + *a*_{*i* + 1}$ 放回原处。他希望执行尽可能少的操作。请找出使序列 $*A*$ 变得美丽所需的最少操作次数（如果可以做到），或者说明这是不可能的。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/69b4319fc56f0d760506d7f84e7647ff65f6bdc5.png) 是最大的非负数 $*d*$，使得对于每个 $*i*$（$1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n*$），$*d*$ 都能整除 $*b*_{*i*}$。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$2 ≤ *n* ≤ 100 000$），表示序列 $*A*$ 的长度。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个以空格分隔的整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$），表示序列 $*A*$ 的元素。

## 输出格式

如果可以通过上述操作使序列 $*A*$ 变得美丽，则在第一行输出 `YES`（不含引号）；否则输出 `NO`（不含引号）。

如果答案为 `YES`，则输出使序列 $*A*$ 变得美丽所需的最少操作次数。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，可以简单地执行一次操作，得到序列 $[0, 2]$，其 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6ddb490b8e898198d30c56c6edce2cf15e6f998a.png)。

在第二个样例中，序列的 $*gcd*$ 已经大于 $1$。
